name: print-social-black-and-pink-outline-portrait-cover-with-script-and-label
title: Greyscale portrait with thick pink outline on black, white script and heavy caps, pink label and crayon squiggles
whatItIs: A black portrait post with a pink pill handle, a greyscale woman resting her chin on a lace cuff cut out with a thick pink outline, crayon pink squiggles, a white script 'Як', heavy white extended 'ПІДВИЩИТИ СВІЙ РІВЕНЬ', a script 'енергії' with a brush underline and a tilted pink label with black rounded text.
whatItMeans: Glamorous and bold; pink outline and script make a mono portrait feel like a magazine cover.
techniques: Add a tilted label for the question.

vocabulary.definition: A thick colour border around a cutout.
A flourished word over bold type.
A rotated colour box with text.
